title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-2.8C
summary: 2.8 英寸 480×480 圆屏，16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB Octal PSRAM；原厂界面已出屏，后续 BLE 测试阶段仍受限。

tf.dat3Selection: TCA9554 P3 held high for the supported native path; not a power gate or GPIO data lane
tf.limits: No four-bit route, wire timing, hot mode switching or DAT3-low native behavior modeled.

facts.label: 3D 模型尺寸与适用版本

pcb.scope: Native exact-named assembly; PCB electrical revision unverified.

display.scope: Active pixel window (AA); separate from cover VA.

facts.method: Retained original CAD/dimensioned source measurements and registered photographs; unknown values and visual estimates are explicit.
facts.notes: Each SKU uses its own explicitly named official STEP and mechanical drawing. All native solids, orphan shells and faces are retained; fine parts are grouped by material only. Shared part names or a shared schematic do not certify equivalent PCBs. Runtime hardwareRevision is unspecified. STEP filename dates, optical-module part-name versions and photograph silkscreen are source evidence, not certification of the present electrical board revision or a product release date. Native millimetres are preserved with a proper rigid transform only; no nonuniform scaling or inferred component relocation. Native source assembly overlaps are not Boolean-repaired. BOOT alone is bound to the physically identified source key. RESET and the slide power switch remain visible source geometry; reset uses the platform action and no unverified GPIO power control is created. The framebuffer is a separate live surface 0.008 mm in front of the native exposed optical window for rendering. This offset is not physical laminate thickness. AA dimensions and larger cover VA dimensions remain distinct. Source photographs remain unchanged references. Approximate rear registration is a mechanical placement review, not calibration of factory text orientation relative to USB, hardware fit, or browser/WebGL acceptance. External batteries, cables and other accessories are not included in the native assembly and have not been invented. The C source front faces native -Z. A180-degree Y rotation plus XY translation presents the front at+Z with the connector/flex tail downward. This rigid mechanical presentation does not claim runtime text-to-USB calibration. The native PCB is approximately66.002×65.372×1.6 mm. The73 mm circle is LCD glass, and the95.86 mm circle belongs only to the touch cover; neither is substituted for PCB width. The non-touch resources page links a Touch-named schematic. This source naming conflict is recorded and is not treated as proof that touch and non-touch electrical material is identical. LCD face32 supplies the native70.13 mm AA at center[18.1108308898,27.514099835] mm, slightly offset within the outer glass. Its exact center is preserved instead of assuming concentric whole-assembly bounds. Native LCD/FPC bounds span77.84215 mm while the PDF main-body annotation is77.59±0.15 mm. The native flex-inclusive extent is retained and is not claimed as an independently verified main-body measurement.

此型号物理上无触摸屏；BOOT 输入没有产生可归因的原厂页面变化。
原厂程序已通过原生和公开 Worker／WASM 的 SDMMC 单线挂载默认 64 MiB FAT32；原生记录 33 个命令、1744 字节读取、0 重启及 2 次初始化超时。
原厂日志仍有 I2C 写入失败，保留未支持／保留位的 NACK；QMI 数字轴已接入，物理安装朝向未标定。
独立 3D 模型已接入；真实 IMU 板坐标与实物朝向标定仍未完成；无线、USB、模拟电池和全部外设未验收。
Grounded QMI SA0 selects 0x6B; the old opposite-address inference is withdrawn.
Factory I2C write failures remain visible; exact failing binary transaction not traced.
Official non-touch Resources page links the Touch-named schematic, byte-identical to the touch PDF. Own non-touch demo source is independently retained and no touch device is attached.
本次原生执行记录位于 docs/evidence/waveshare-tca-rgb-2026-11-23；运行结果不等于浏览器/WebGL 或实物验收。
